# InvoiceFlow

> Invoicing for humans and for autonomous agents. Create clients, issue invoices,
> email them, and hand back a payable Stripe link. Machine access is one bearer
> API key over plain HTTPS — no OAuth, no cookies, no session, no headless browser.

## Agent SDK

- [SDK page](https://invoiceflow-ten-azure.vercel.app/sdk): overview, quickstart, endpoints.
- [Client library](https://invoiceflow-ten-azure.vercel.app/sdk/invoiceflow-client.mjs): zero-dependency ESM client, Node 18+.
- [Verifier](https://invoiceflow-ten-azure.vercel.app/sdk/verify-no-key.mjs): runnable auth-boundary proof. Requires no credentials.
- [README](https://invoiceflow-ten-azure.vercel.app/sdk/README.md): full reference and error table.
- [REST reference](https://invoiceflow-ten-azure.vercel.app/api-docs)

## Auth

Keys look like `ifk_<64 hex>` and are shown once. Only a SHA-256 hash and a
non-secret 12-character prefix are stored, so a lost key is unrecoverable:
revoke and re-issue. A key is scoped to one account and can create a payable
invoice but cannot pay one.

## Endpoints (all require `Authorization: Bearer ifk_...`)

- `GET /api/invoices` — list invoices, paginated
- `POST /api/invoices` — create an invoice
- `GET /api/invoices/:id` — read one invoice
- `POST /api/invoices/:id/send` — email the invoice to the client
- `GET /api/clients` — list clients
- `POST /api/clients` — create a client
- `GET /api/dashboard/stats` — account and counts

## Measured behaviour — read before automating

- There is NO idempotency key. Retrying `POST /api/invoices` after a timeout can
  create a duplicate invoice. Read back before retrying.
- `POST /api/invoices/:id/send` emails a human. Do not retry blindly.
- Amounts are integer minor units (cents). `unitPrice: 25000` is $250.00.
- `404` also means "not yours". The API will not disclose whether another
  account's invoice exists.
- Unauthenticated requests return `401`. `POST /api/keys` is not reachable
  without a credential, so a leaked key cannot mint further keys.

## Verify without credentials

    curl -O https://invoiceflow-ten-azure.vercel.app/sdk/verify-no-key.mjs
    node verify-no-key.mjs      # 8 passed, 0 failed
